ondevice_languages.description: Comma-separated languages Chrome's on-device model can read/write. Others are routed to the cloud.

max_ondevice_chars.description: Largest document sent to Gemini Nano in one shot (its window is ~9k tokens).

chunk_chars.description: Chunk size for on-device map-reduce of long documents.

max_chunked_chars.description: Above this size we stop trying on-device map-reduce and use the cloud.

force_mode.description: Kill-switch / experiment: '' | prefer_on_device | only_on_device | prefer_in_cloud | only_in_cloud. PII is still masked.

pii_redaction.description: Mask CNIC/cards/IBAN/phones/e-mails before anything can reach the cloud.

images_enabled.description: Allow on-device image (photo of a document) input.

cloud_model.description: Gemini model used for cloud fallback via Firebase AI Logic.

nano_temperature.description: On-device sampling temperature (only applied together with nano_top_k > 0).

nano_top_k.description: On-device topK. 0 leaves Chrome's defaults untouched.
